newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile sees economy growing five pct in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Chile sees economy growing five pct in Q4.

text.p: Chile's economic growth will slow to five percent in the last quarter of the year which will bring the expansion within the government's seven percent target for the year, said Economy Minister Alvaro Garcia.

"We are reaching a level of growth which is compatible with growth objectives for next year and with the likely acceleration of growth which should happen in 1997," Garcia told a seminar on the supermarket industry.
Economic expansion cooled to 5.8 percent in the third quarter of the year from eight percent in the first half of the year, said Garcia.
The economy has slowed as the result of the central bank's restrictive monetary policy which has kept interest rates high for the last year.
The government's 1997 budget assumes growth will speed up slightly to 5.75 percent next year.
